about: The factions a player pledges to, one for each Art (bible/05-Decisions/Factions Keep the Arts.md), with Claude's numbers (Factions and Vendors as Claude Shapes Them.md). Read by the rules (the gear crate) and the client alike. Prices in Aurem; reputation as kill XP counts it.

factions.name: Stormcallers
factions.words: Keepers of the Storm Art. Quick feet, and lightning in the hand.

factions.name: Lamplighters
factions.words: Keepers of the Divine Art. They mend, and they light the way for others.

factions.name: The Veiled
factions.words: Keepers of the Shadow Art. Few in Overlook could name one.
